facebook.caption:
Tourists walk straight past this. Locals stop here every time.

Quốc Mẫu Hall sits inside Thiền viện Trúc Lâm Hộ Quốc, one of the most visually striking temple complexes on the island. Most visitors photograph the main gate and leave. Get deeper in and this hall stops you cold.

Incense smoke, total silence, zero crowds. Phu Quoc has a side that isn't beaches and bars. This is it.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
